lines.context: Not Very Moldy Bread：Consuming Not Very Moldy Bread
lines.text: You consumed a Not Very Moldy Bread and gained +%1$s☯ Farming Wisdom for 60m!
lines.raw: §7You consumed a §9Not Very Moldy Bread §7and gained §3+%1$s☯ Farming Wisdom §7for §a60m§7!
lines.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通呈现页的带色文本；未实机逐字验证。
lines.zh: 你吃下了不太发霉的面包,获得 +%1$s☯ 耕作智慧,持续 60 分钟!

lines.context: Not Very Moldy Bread：First Very Moldy Bread
lines.text: It feels like eating a sponge with the aftertaste of some grass.
lines.raw: §aIt feels like eating a sponge with the aftertaste of some grass.
lines.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通呈现页的带色文本；未实机逐字验证。
lines.zh: 口感像在吃海绵,回味里还带着青草味。
lines.wiki_last_edited: This page was last edited on 14 September 2026, at 22:42.

lines.context: Not Very Moldy Bread：Second Very Moldy Bread
lines.text: The mold coming into contact with your throat is a visceral, horrifying, feeling.
lines.raw: §aThe mold coming into contact with your throat is a visceral, horrifying, feeling.
lines.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通呈现页的带色文本；未实机逐字验证。
lines.zh: 霉菌滑过喉咙,那股触感让人毛骨悚然。
lines.wiki_last_edited: This page was last edited on 14 September 2026, at 22:42.

lines.context: Not Very Moldy Bread：Third Very Moldy Bread
lines.text: On the way down the mold scratches your tongue, the taste of pure moss shakes you to your core.
lines.raw: §aOn the way down the mold scratches your tongue, the taste of pure moss shakes you to your core.
lines.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通呈现页的带色文本；未实机逐字验证。
lines.zh: 霉菌一路刮过舌头,满嘴苔藓味,让你浑身一颤。
lines.wiki_last_edited: This page was last edited on 14 September 2026, at 22:42.

lines.context: Not Very Moldy Bread：Fourth Very Moldy Bread
lines.text: Your stomach cannot take much more of this.
lines.raw: §aYour stomach cannot take much more of this.
lines.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通呈现页的带色文本；未实机逐字验证。
lines.zh: 你的胃已经快承受不住了。
lines.wiki_last_edited: This page was last edited on 14 September 2026, at 22:42.

lines.context: Not Very Moldy Bread：Fifth Very Moldy Bread
lines.text: As fast as it went down it started coming back up. You strained your throat, forcing it back down. Never again.
lines.raw: §aAs fast as it went down it started coming back up. You strained your throat, forcing it back down. Never again.
lines.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通呈现页的带色文本；未实机逐字验证。
lines.zh: 刚咽下去就涌了上来。你绷紧喉咙,硬生生又咽了回去。再也不吃了。
